notes:
v0.6.23: fix SIGPIPE-on-pipefail bug in reticulumpi-bootstrap.sh.

Caught during the validation run on a fresh ReticulumHF flash.
Phase 1's verify check (apt-cache policy zerotier-one | grep -q
"download.zerotier.com") returned non-zero under the script's
`set -euo pipefail` mode even though the policy clearly showed
the package as available.

Root cause: with pipefail, when `grep -q` matches and exits,
the producer (apt-cache) is still writing. The pipe closes,
producer gets SIGPIPE on next write, and the pipeline returns
141 (128+13 = SIGPIPE). Even though grep itself succeeded,
pipefail propagates the producer's non-zero exit.

Fix: write the producer's output to a temp file first, then
grep the file. No pipe = no SIGPIPE. Applied to 5 places in
the script:
  - Phase 1: apt-cache policy zerotier-one
  - Phase 10: launcher status (All components match)
  - Phase 10: launcher status (v0. match)
  - Phase 10: noVNC WebSockify check
  - Phase 11: zerotier-cli status (ONLINE)

The 3 remaining `file | grep -q "ARM aarch64"` patterns are
short-output producers and don't need the fix.
